entities.title: Lundey
entities.summary: An original single-player maze chase for the browser: a puffin gathers sand eels in a burrow maze dug afresh from a seed on every level, hunted by a fox, a mink, a skua and a raven. For invited players.
entities.purpose: Holds the whole game: the browser game in src/ (a pure engine, a canvas UI and the page's loop), the page in public/, the Worker that serves it to invited players in worker/, and the tests in test/. It is one npm project and one Cloudflare Worker.
boundaries: Original work: the game, its maze generator, its characters, its art and its sounds were all made for this repository (README.md).

Invite-only: every file is served only to players signed in to icelander.net who hold games:lundey, checked with the shared library in vendor/icelander-auth/, never edited here. Whether the game, its place on the games page and that role stand in for what the owner asked for is an open decision (decisions.json, stands-in-for-request).
Nothing is kept on a server: no database, no Durable Object, no secrets and no API. The best score lives in the player's browser.
On its own: no online play, no lobby and no shared table, and the page loads nothing from the games hub.
